The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Terrak Morrhage]] studied under a [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Sith Master''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sigil]]. Morrhage's [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] was eventually tracked down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and Morrhage swore vengeance upon the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as a result.
